one_sentence_description: AI-assisted Solidity audit reports with verifiable 0G Storage persistence and 0G Chain proof registration.

summary.what_it_does: Analyzes Solidity contracts with Slither, RAG, deterministic scoring, trace evidence, and JSON/Markdown report generation.
summary.problem_it_solves: Makes AI-assisted smart contract audit reports easier to trust by packaging each report as a reproducible artifact, uploading it to 0G Storage, and registering proof on 0G Chain.
